description: Customer worries about policy lapse if premium payment is delayed. Agent resolves via Q2 KB.

transcript.caller: Ilang araw po ba ang grace period bago mag-lapse ang policy?
transcript.agent:
Nauunawaan ko po ang inyong pag-aalala. 2. Grace Period & Policy Lapse (Palugit at Mawalan ng Bisa):
A 31-day grace period (31 araw na palugit) is provided for overdue premium payments bago mag-lapse ang policy. If unpaid within 31 calendar days, the policy coverage will temporarily lapse (mawalan ng bisa ang coverage). Reinstatement is available within 2 years subject to health evidence.
